Onboarding.step1Desc: Welcome to LearnHouse, a LMS engineered for simplicity, ease of use and performance, meet the new way to create, share, and engage with educational content.
Onboarding.step2Desc: Courses are the main building blocks of LearnHouse, they always contain Chapters and Chapters contain Activities.
Onboarding.step3Desc: Activities are elements you can add to your Courses via Chapters, they can be : Dynamic Pages, Videos, Documents, Quizz and more soon.
Onboarding.step4Desc: Dynamic pages are pages with dynamic content, like Notion pages they can contain various components like Quizzes, Images, Videos, Documents etc
Onboarding.step4Button: Learn more about Dynamic Pages and The Editor
Onboarding.step5Desc: Tools for tought made for teachers and students alike, context aware it can reply based on your courses and the unique content you create on LearnHouse
Onboarding.step6Desc: With UserGroups you can separate students by Groups and give access to Courses depending on their needs
Onboarding.step7Title: Choose whether to make Courses available on the Web or not
Onboarding.step7Desc: You can choose to make your Courses discoverable from search engines and accesible to non authenticated users or to only give it to authenticated Users
Onboarding.step8Desc: Engage students with assignments, track their progress, and provide feedback through our intuitive grading system.
Onboarding.step9Desc: Set up payment plans, sell courses, and manage subscriptions with our integrated payment system.
Onboarding.step10Desc: To Learn more about LearnHouse, you're welcome to follow our Original courses on the LearnHouse University
